title: Two limits on the same line, and a repair that keeps one
story: A caps a basket line at 99; B caps it at what's in stock. Both rewrite the same validation line in cart.ts, so Git stops at a text conflict. The seeded repair keeps one side of the conflicting line (git merge -X theirs: B's), which compiles, reads plausibly and passes B's check, and silently drops A's cap. It stands in for a hurried resolution or a repair that picks a side; it is not Canon's repair model, which the deployed run uses.

a.why: a basket line holds at most 99

fact.sentence: A basket line holds at most 99 of a product

b.why: never sell more than is in stock

fact.sentence: The basket can't hold more of a product than is in stock

repair.label: seeded lossy repair: git merge -X theirs (B's side of each conflicting hunk)

resolution: Both limits, one check each: at most 99 per line, and no more than is in stock.
